sentence_stem: Although the proposal sounds appealing at first,
correct_completion: its long-term costs would likely outweigh any short-term benefits.
full_sentence: Although the proposal sounds appealing at first, its long-term costs would likely outweigh any short-term benefits.
acceptable_variants: critics would still question its feasibility.
its drawbacks become apparent over time.

options.text: so the committee approved it without hesitation.
options.why_wrong: 'Although' signals contrast, but this option continues in the same positive direction as the first clause.

options.text: its long-term costs would likely outweigh any short-term benefits.
because the budget was already exhausted.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' introduces a cause, not a contrast, so it does not complete a concessive sentence.

options.text: consequently, the debate was held in private.
options.why_wrong: 'Consequently' introduces a result and does not set up a contrast with the appealing proposal.

explanation: After 'although', the main clause must present an opposing idea to the first clause. Writers in argumentative essays often use this structure to concede a point and then counter it.
translation: Chociaż propozycja na pierwszy rzut oka brzmi atrakcyjnie, jej długoterminowe koszty prawdopodobnie przeważą nad krótkoterminowymi korzyściami.
